name: Yrjo
desc: A harbor officer from Nasha Town who has his work cut out for him. Previously able to refine his TCG skills by dueling visiting players, recent changes in work duties has meant that any free time he has left is now being used to deal with goods, people and animals.

customize.text:
<color=#ffd680>Stage Introduction</color>
As an experienced harbor officer, Yrjo knows all too well how adversity can test a person's mindset — and that mindset is the key to victory in high-level Genius Invokation TCG. His approach is therefore to carefully craft unfavorable conditions to throw his opponent off balance, and then seize the win through clever manipulation.
